analysis:
Changes: (1) docs/architecture/inference.md adds a paragraph at head lines 715-718 on Qwen 3.5 forced tool_choice and bumps the date. This is a documentation-only change. (2) ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy.swift replaces the single hardcoded model ID `qwen38ConstrainedModelID` (base line 18) with `ModelRuntimeRequirements.qwen38ConcreteModelIDs.contains(model.id)` in advertisesCapability (head ~line 75). This now also advertises forced tools for the embedded-MTP Qwen3.8 build. The Qwen35TemplateFix.applies(context) gate is retained. Separately, validateParser (head ~line 151) now treats any model_type with the prefix `qwen3_5` as nativeQwen, so the accepted framed parser format is `.qwen35` or `.xmlFunction` instead of `.nemotron`.

Security assessment: forced tool choice stays fail-closed under .structuredPostValidation (parse, function selection and schema validation before exposure). Widening the accepted parser set to `.qwen35` for Qwen 3.5 types does not weaken that post-validation. It affects only structured output enforcement, not the encryption, attestation, or key custody boundaries (T-008, T-011, A-001). No threat-model assets or boundaries are affected. The concrete ID set `ModelRuntimeRequirements.qwen38ConcreteModelIDs` is defined outside the supplied evidence. I could not verify that it contains only intended Eigen-published IDs. The unverified contract is that forcedStrategy still routes through Qwen35TemplateFix.applies/nativeStructuredTarget, which is unchanged. Next pass: confirm that set's contents and that the `qwen3_5` prefix match (also covers `qwen3_5_moe`) does not accept unintended types. Only low-risk coordinator-visible capability advertisement changes.
